repin_history.decision: DELIBERATE RE-PIN (FR-125/FR-132), authorized by the maintainer 2026-10-15 (request: resolve the failing test_035 unit tests on main).
repin_history.rationale: flexicon added two OPTIONAL parameters to FLExProject.OpenProject: strict_transactions=False (67d5e6f, #210 -- opt-in Phase-1 rollback guard; the False default keeps the historical degraded Phase-1 behaviour) and progress=None (8594a6e, #289 -- None now means a HeadlessThreadedProgress instead of constructing a ProgressDialogWithTask per open). strict_transactions was inserted BEFORE ui, so a caller passing ui POSITIONALLY (5th argument) would now bind it to strict_transactions. Audited: every GramTrans OpenProject call in src/, tests/ and debug/ passes at most projectName positionally and everything else by keyword (Lib/api.py passes writeEnabled=True, undoable=False by keyword), so no call site rebinds. The undoable=True default pinned in drift_observed_at_capture is unchanged.
repin_history.method: Re-measured with preflight.introspect_capabilities() and diffed field-by-field against the previous pin via preflight.diff_capabilities(); exactly 3 differences, all on the OpenProject signature; only that entry was replaced with its measured value. Post-apply diff is empty.
repin_history.consequence: progress=None changes the DEFAULT progress object at open time (headless, no WinForms handle). Not live-verified by upstream at 8594a6e; GramTrans never passes progress= so it rides the new default.
